notes: GenApp's Db2 'inquire policy' (LGIPDB01, LINKed by LGIPOL01 with the 32500-byte LGCMAREA COMMAREA; the COMMAREA is described by the record the caller passes, LGIPOL01's DFHCOMMAREA (COPY LGCMAREA), since LGIPDB01 includes the same copybook with EXEC SQL INCLUDE: the generated DTO is the caller's): the request id, upper-cased, picks the inquiry -- 01IEND / 01IHOU / 01IMOT / 01ICOM a SELECT INTO on POLICY joined with ENDOWMENT / HOUSE / MOTOR / COMMERCIAL by customer and policy number; 02ICOM a commercial SELECT by policy number alone (returning the customer number); 03ICOM the scroll cursor Cust_Cursor over a customer's commercial policies; 05ICOM the cursor Zip_Cursor over COMMERCIAL rows with CA-B-POSTCODE; anything else '99'. A row found is moved into CA-POLICY-COMMON and the type's area, marked 'FINAL'; +100 gives '01'. Tables (unqualified: the bind's QUALIFIER, GENASA1) are GenApp's own (base/cntl/db2cre.jcl: DDL and INSERTs, <DB2DBID> = GENASA1) and compared after every scenario. Seed: @case/seed.sql, every INSERT of db2cre.jcl plus customer 11 (as genapp-lgacdb02's) and three policies of customer 11 with brokerId and payment NULL, the endowment one with PADDINGDATA set (GenApp's own INSERTs never leave them NULL or set it). Not reachable here: a COMMAREA too short for the policy ('98', l.390-392, 487-489, 581-583, 689-691, 793-795) -- the harness passes the whole 32500-byte COMMAREA; OPEN failing ('89' l.843-847, 926-930: no declared fault yet); more than one row from either cursor and the 20-row cap (l.907-908) -- each seeded customer and zipcode has at most one commercial policy. Derived from the CICS General Insurance Application (GenApp, github.com/cicsdev/cics-genapp; (C) Copyright IBM Corp. 2011, 2021), licensed under the Eclipse Public License 2.0: LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived. A negative SQLCODE on each SELECT INTO ('90', l.426-428 and its copies) and on each CLOSE ('88', l.855-859, 938-942) is a declared SQL fault (-904, M2): the auto fault of a SELECT INTO is +100 and a CLOSE gets none. #4607 / X6 (owner decision): LGSTSQ runs in the same task ("programs"; "region" for its ASSIGN SYSID). An EIBCALEN-0 task (no-commarea) LINKs it with the short ERROR-MSG and ABENDs LGCA, compared whole (the WRITEQ TD and WRITEQ TS it writes too). An error path with the 32500-byte COMMAREA LINKs it a second time with the 99-byte CA-ERROR-MSG; LGSTSQ then writes 104 bytes from its 95-byte WRITE-MSG (X6), so that task is judged up to the refused WRITEQ: what it did before is compared, its end state is not. Not settled on z/OS (#4050). Still not reached: IF EIBCALEN < 91 true (a COMMAREA shorter than 91 bytes; the harness passes the case's whole COMMAREA).
